verdict.rationale: Poke is documented only as a hosted assistant that runs in Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, and RCS, with usage-based credits. Nothing in the pack shows a downloadable, open-source, or on-premises deployment of the core product. The `npx poke tunnel` command only exposes a user's local MCP server to the hosted Poke service. That is an adjacent capability and does not count as self-hosting Poke itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
